rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for hot water vapour itself.

example.english: When you boil water, there will be lots of steam, so be careful not to get burned.
example.traditional: 煲滾水嗰陣會有好多水蒸氣，小心辣親。
example.jyutping: bou1 gwan2 seoi2 go2 zan6 wui5 jau5 hou2 do1 seoi2 zing1 hei3 siu2 sam1 laat6 can1

rows.note: Use 蒸汽 specifically for pressurized steam used in machinery, heating, or industrial settings.

example.english: The factory uses steam to power this machine.
example.traditional: 工場用蒸汽推動呢部機器。
example.jyutping: gung1 coeng4 jung6 zing1 hei3 teoi1 dung6 ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3

rows.note: Use 一肚氣 for anger or resentment that someone is holding in.

example.english: I was full of pent-up steam all night after being wrongly blamed.
example.traditional: 畀人屈咗，我成晚都一肚氣。
example.jyutping: bei2 jan4 wat1 zo2 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 jat1 tou5 hei3

rows.note: Use 動力 for the inner drive or motive power behind progress, rather than literal steam.

example.english: Your support is the steam that keeps me going.
example.traditional: 你嘅支持係我繼續行落去嘅動力。
example.jyutping: nei5 ge3 zi1 ci4 hai6 ngo5 gai3 zuk6 haang4 lok6 heoi3 ge3 dung6 lik6
